turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a snowstorm coming Thursday night and I'm supposed to drive to my sister's on Friday.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That could make the roads rough. Would you rather leave Thursday afternoon before it hits, or wait and go Saturday?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One sec, I'm going to talk with my neighbor. Please wait until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Rosa, are you still playing that farming game?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Every night. I'm in my third year now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it worth getting? It looks kind of slow.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It is slow. That's the point. It's relaxing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can we play it together or is it single player?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: You can do co-op. Get it and I'll show you around my farm.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done talking to them. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. We were deciding whether you beat the storm Thursday or wait until Saturday.
